title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science - Pre Vocational Studies - Farm Structures and Buildings
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Simple constructions built on the farm to perform specific agricultural functions, which are usually not designed for human habitation, are called ________.
questions.explain: Farm structures are simple constructions like fences, silos, barns, and feed troughs, designed for specific operational purposes rather than for housing humans.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is best described as a farm building rather than a simple farm structure?
questions.explain: A farm office (or a farm house, poultry house) has standard walls, a roof, and is designed for habitation or complex shelter, categorizing it as a farm building.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A farm structure specially designed for the bulk storage of harvested grains such as maize and guinea corn is called a ________.
questions.explain: A silo is a tall, cylindrical farm structure built primarily for the safe, bulk storage of threshed grains to protect them from pests and weather.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following farm structures is used to restrict the movement of large farm animals to allow for easy vaccination and treatment?
questions.explain: An animal crush is a specially built wooden or metal corridor structure used to hold cattle and other large animals tightly to restrict their movement during veterinary treatments like vaccination.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is the primary agricultural purpose of erecting fences around the farm perimeter?
options: To protect crops and livestock from wild animals and thieves
To provide support for climbing crops like yams
questions.explain: Fences are farm structures used primarily for security; they keep intruders and predators out while keeping farm animals safely enclosed.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: One effective routine maintenance practice to prevent rusting of metallic farm structures like gates and silos is ________.
questions.explain: Metallic structures are prone to rusting due to moisture and air. Painting and greasing create a protective layer that prevents rust and prolongs their lifespan.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following maintenance activities is crucial for prolonging the life of farm buildings made of wood?
options: Removing the roof during the dry season
questions.explain: Wooden farm buildings are easily attacked by termites and rot. Treating the wood with anti-termite chemicals (wood preservatives) is the best way to maintain them.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is considered a farm building because it provides complete shelter for farm activities or habitation?
questions.explain: A poultry house is a farm building because it typically has walls, a roof, and provides a controlled environment and permanent shelter for birds. The other options are mere farm structures.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies
